title: Most-viewed Trending verified with controlled data
summary: Four ranking regressions and three Expo browser scenarios passed. Live analytics verification remains blocked by an unavailable response.

changes.detail: Verified the four-product cap, descending recorded view totals, exclusion of unclicked/unavailable items and safe behavior when the API has no data or lacks the new mode.

validation.name: Ranking API regressions
validation.detail: node --test tests/trending-clicks.test.ts: 4/4 passed. Covers aggregation, ordering, cap, unavailable products, invalid counts, empty results, analytics pagination and query errors.

validation.name: Expo browser scenarios
validation.detail: Actual Expo search page at 520px with intercepted test API responses: displayed d,b,a,c in API rank order and limited to four despite six supplied slugs; zero cards for empty data and an older catalogue-strategy API response. Evidence: artifacts/trending-clicks-20261025/browser-results.json. These were controlled fixtures, not live popularity results.

validation.name: Mobile TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: Mobile tsc --noEmit and ESLint for changed mobile files passed. Root ESLint for the recommendation route passed. git diff --check passed.

validation.name: History validation
validation.detail: 921 reports valid before this follow-up; all four history tests passed. Final manifest checked after append.

validation.name: Full website typecheck
validation.detail: Unrelated existing components/ProductGallery.tsx(218,86) TS18047: videoDimensions is possibly null. Left existing work untouched.

validation.name: Live analytics query
validation.detail: GET http://localhost:3000/api/recommendations?mode=most-viewed&limit=4 returned HTTP 503 Trending unavailable. Live popularity results are not verified.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No deployment or database changes. Uses existing recorded website product views; native/mobile product opens are not currently sent to this shared analytics source. Real devices not tested. Updated backend must be deployed separately before production-backed mobile can receive the new ranking.
